# Generated: do not edit

`libmp3lame.so` in each folder is LAME 3.100, compiled for that Android ABI by
[tools/build-lame.ps1](../../../../../tools/build-lame.ps1). The script holds the
download link, the expected SHA-256 and the compiler flags. To change anything here,
change the script and run it again.

They are committed so a normal build needs neither the LAME source nor the NDK.

LAME is LGPL 2.1. It is linked dynamically, so it can be replaced by rebuilding the
library on its own. Source: https://lame.sourceforge.io
